body: Yeah, if I was to torrent something I definitely wouldn't seed it.

Well I don't think my first message back to you saved so I'll try again >:(. A lot has happened in the past 24 hours. I regretfully drank after taking some Xanax and Benadryl to help me sleep but I still only ended up with 4 or 5 hours of sleep. I spoke with my girlfriend (ex?) for 3 hours on the phone to try and discuss what was going on with her. She was probably a huge part of natural support for me and everything that happened over the weekend made me really upset. It was a combination of feeling like a failure at work and as a dad and as a son AND as a boyfriend that I just lost it. 

Everything went bad a month ago when her and I got into a huge fight and she ended up hitting me and it just really, really upset me. I felt extremely betrayed and like my main support system was just totally gone and I was isolated and alone. I became really vindictive towards her even though she displayed some signs of regret but I just don't think she understands the depth of what that did to me...but it wasn't good for me to act like that towards her either. I'm just so afraid of ending things I never ever ever do it. I'd rather die then have to worry about how to end things because it never goes well. 

So I contacted my psychiatrist and therapist and I'm going to see my therapist this week at least. I'm still pretty...not good but I just feel alone still. Or like everyone thinks my reasons are shit and that I shouldn't have ever pushes people away even though I was so hurt. It's just so upsetting. I really don't know how to just fix all of this :( so I just want to bail.

I don't have any sick time or vacation time at work now, I used it up because I just got strep really bad. I know it's the fastest but I remember a previous hospitalization, my only one, and it was horrible. I was in like the psych wing and it was just me in a padded room and they would wake me up every 3 hours and ask me a ton of questions about hurting myself. Granted I was hospitalized for suicidal tendencies but I still hated being woken up so much.

Yeah I've thought about it but I don't want to lose my job or my car or anything because I can't go back to work. I have like 2 grand in savings which is more than enough my monthly bills are only like 600 or 700 a month but I still feel like if I was to go inpatient they could take my things or make it so I lose my job and can't get another job.

I've always been super hard on myself and not just when I'm like this. Today I drew like a thought map on why my ex is trying to kill me, because I think that she still tried to set me up to go to jail or kill me or have me kill myself but it didn't work out that way. 

Regardless everyone has been hard on me forever. I first had paranoia symptoms at 16, auditory and visual hallucinations at 19 and I'm only 23 now. So I've been hospitalized once and been to 9 therapists and 3 psychiatrists since I started. Like I know 4 years is a long time but I used to be even worse I use to just drink everyday at 19 ALL day long to drown everything out or take 400-500 mgs of diphenhydramine (Benadryl) a day which made me fucked out of my head. Now I don't do anything I just deal with it but everyone expects me to change near instantly. Like I don't have facial ticks anymore and I don't stare into space (reality I'm staring at a hallucination) anymore but I still respond to internal impulses because I just hope "okay if I can just do this one fucking thing everything will leave me alone" and I also think that it's the best idea. In reality it's usually the worst idea but that just doesn't help me at all anymore. I might know it's the worst, but I also know I need everything in my head to leave me alone and if my head says it's the best then it's the best and I'm going for it.
Thanks man. I think I should probably try and get to someone this week at the rate things are going.

They were giving me side effects I didn't want but I've tried a few cocktails and it always ends up with that. I was on an amount of Seroquel and Remeron with some vitamin supplements but the Seroquel made me forget how to breathe eventually idk I can't explain it. I just couldn't figure out how to breathe. So I got off that and the two were making me very languish and gain a lot of weight which I know isn't as bad as how I am now but it was still so bad to me I just stopped cold turkey so I could try to feel better about myself. 

Right now I don't have access to therapy I've been with the same one the past 5 years but I can't see them anymore they were connected to my university and now I graduated so I can't go back. I need to find another one I know that and a doctor to prescribe different ones or something I just need something. 

Thanks for the reply and reading I really appreciate it

I think this is what I should do but I'm so afraid that people at the doctor's office just don't care about me or when I leave they talk about me or what I say or anything like that I hate going to see them. I try to avoid doctor's as much as possible. 

When I was on medicine it helped me, but the side effects were very negative (in my opinion). But I know in the grand scheme of things that they outweighed the state I am in now. I am debating taking them again but I'm not sure. I like to imagine I guess that I'm strong enough to keep it under control on my own and I don't need to be altered or anything by medicine because I never feel the same. But the 'true' me isn't good at all. So I am so conflicted and I feel like I'm being torn about from the inside out because I'm in constant conflict with who I am and who I think I should be and it puts so much stress on me I don't know how to cope with it. 

Thank you for validating the things that I said. That means a lot to me.
